one_line: De facto ruler and ceremonial king of Mysore in the mid-18th century Deccan, sharing a tense balance of power in a militarised court.

appearance.age_look: Hyder Ali appears in his late 40s with a solid, soldierly build; Krishnaraja Wodeyar II appears in his early 30s with a slimmer, courtly frame.
appearance.face: Hyder has an oval, weathered medium-brown face with a strong nose, neatly trimmed moustache, faint lines around sharp, alert eyes and a default expression of calm strategic focus; Krishnaraja has a rounder, fair-to-medium brown face with softer features, thinner arched brows, a small refined moustache and a composed, slightly reserved expression.
appearance.hair: Hyder’s hair is black, kept short and hidden under a white, slightly conical Mysore-style turban with a narrow gold border and a small green feather tucked on the left; Krishnaraja’s long black hair is neatly tied in a low knot at the back and covered by a rich dark-red silk turban with broad gold zari bands and a small central jewelled sarpech-like ornament.
appearance.costume: Hyder wears an off-white, long-waisted cotton angarkha-style coat reaching mid-calf with a wrap-over front and subtle narrow stripes, fastened with small cloth ties, over a light chain-mail vest hinted beneath the neckline, paired with deep indigo churidar trousers and a broad dark-green wool waist-sash where a slim dagger hilt shows; his feet are in brown leather mojari-style shoes with modest upturned toes; Krishnaraja wears a knee-length cream-coloured silk angarkha with intricate but fine gold floral buta motifs and a slightly flared skirt, over a pale gold silk cummerbund, teamed with soft maroon silk churidars and dark-brown court slippers with understated gold edging, plus a delicate, era-appropriate pearl-and-gold necklace, slim gold bangles and a simple signet ring.
appearance.signature: Hyder carries a long, gently curved steel sabre in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings held at his left hip by the green waist-sash, while Krishnaraja holds a slender, polished palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red thread as a symbol of royal authority and ritual knowledge.

ref_desc: Hyder Ali is a late-40s, medium-brown, sharp-eyed soldier with a white gold-edged turban, off-white angarkha over deep indigo churidar, dark-green sash and sabre at his hip, beside Krishnaraja Wodeyar II, a slimmer, fairer king in cream-gold angarkha, maroon churidar and dark-red gold-banded turban holding a palm-leaf manuscript.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet showing two standing male figures from 18th-century Mysore together: Hyder Ali and Krishnaraja Wodeyar II. Hyder Ali should look like a late-40s, medium-brown, weathered-faced man with a strong nose, neatly trimmed moustache and sharp, alert eyes, his expression calm and strategic; his black hair is hidden under a white Mysore-style turban with a narrow gold border and a small green feather on the left. He wears an off-white, long-waisted cotton angarkha-style coat with a wrap-over front and subtle narrow stripes reaching mid-calf, hint of chain-mail visible at the neckline, over deep indigo churidar trousers, a broad dark-green waist-sash and brown leather mojari-style shoes with modest upturned toes; at his left hip, secured by the sash, hangs his signature long, gently curved steel sabre in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings. Beside him, Krishnaraja Wodeyar II should appear as a slimmer, early-30s fair-to-medium brown man with a rounder face, softer features, small refined moustache and a composed, slightly reserved expression; his long black hair is tied in a low knot and covered by a dark-red silk turban with broad gold zari bands and a small jewelled central ornament. He wears a knee-length cream-coloured silk angarkha with fine gold floral buta motifs and a slightly flared skirt, a pale gold silk cummerbund, maroon silk churidar trousers, dark-brown court slippers with subtle gold edging, and modest royal jewellery: a pearl-and-gold necklace, slim gold bangles and a simple signet ring. He holds his signature prop, a slender polished palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red thread, cradled in one hand. Keep proportions shonen-anime, but costumes, jewellery and weapons strictly 18th-century Mysore, with a dominant palette of off-white, deep indigo, dark green, cream gold and maroon, and show them front-facing with clear head-to-toe details for consistent redraws.
